title: Low balance alert
description: Warn customers on WhatsApp when their account balance falls below a threshold they set. A short utility alert for banks and wallets.
notes: This works as utility only because the customer opted into the alert; do not add loan or overdraft offers to the text.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your {{account_type}} account ending in {{last4}} has a balance of *{{balance}}*, which is below the alert limit you set of {{threshold}}. Consider adding funds soon.
